record.label: Controlled Givens angles from paired one-hot SELECT
record.statement: Each SELECT call uses 145 one-hot qubits to denote pairs of orbital vectors. Another qubit selects a member of the active pair. The circuit uses CNOT parities to compute the controlled Givens angle bits.
record.boundary: In Appendix I.3, the paired register covers 261 two-body orbital vectors and 29 one-body vectors in each SELECT call. At the workspace width of the first eight blocks, the rotations and their angles use 11,818 T gates per call, compared with 18,844 T gates for the batched QROM baseline.
